{'text': '更新，美東時間下午5:56：公開測試版亦已同步推出。', 'paragraph_context': 'Update, 5:56 p.m. ET: The public beta is now available as well.'}

{'text': 'Apple 正在向開發者推出 macOS 27.2 Golden Gate 第四個開發者測試版，正式版本預計將於未來數星期內發佈。以下是大家可以期待的新功能。', 'paragraph_context': 'Apple is rolling out the fourth developer beta for macOS 27.2 Golden Gate, ahead of the official release in the coming weeks. Here’s what to expect.'}

{'text': 'Apple 推出 macOS 27.2 開發者測試版 4', 'paragraph_context': 'Apple rolls out macOS 27.2 developer beta 4'}

{'text': '在第二及第三個開發者測試版相隔兩星期後，Apple 似乎已回復 27.2 測試版的每週更新週期。', 'paragraph_context': 'Apple appears to be back to its weekly cycle of the 27.2 beta, after a two-week gap between developer betas 2 and 3.'}

{'text': '公司現正為開發者推出 macOS 27.2 測試版 4，今次更新在用戶層面功能上屬較少的一輪。系統至今最大的新增功能，是 Siri AI 支援多五種語言——上月隨 macOS 27 Golden Gate 推出時，Siri AI 僅支援英語。', 'paragraph_context': 'The company is now rolling out macOS 27.2 beta 4 to developers, which is on the lighter side of user-facing features. The biggest addition to the system so far is Siri AI’s support for five additional languages, following its English-only initial rollout last month with macOS 27 Golden Gate.'}

{'text': 'macOS 27.2 Golden Gate 的 Siri AI 將新增支援法文、日文、韓文、葡萄牙文及西班牙文，這正是 Apple 在 Surprise and Shine 活動上承諾過的內容。', 'paragraph_context': 'Siri AI in macOS 27.2 Golden Gate will add support for French, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, and Spanish, as Apple promised during the Surprise and Shine event.'}

{'text': '上星期推出的 macOS 27.2 測試版 3 有一項相當有趣的發現，就是在多個內置應用程式中找到新增的手勢辨識工具，這或許是為 Apple 即將推出的觸控屏幕 MacBook Pro 鋪路。', 'paragraph_context': 'One particularly interesting addition to macOS 27.2 beta 3, released last week, was the discovery of new gesture recognition tools in several built-in apps, which could be laying the groundwork for Apple’s upcoming touchscreen MacBook Pro.'}

{'text': 'Apple 預計將於本月底較後時間發表旗下首部觸控屏幕 MacBook Pro，目前傳聞發佈日期為 10 月 27 日。公司同時預計會推出配備 OLED 屏幕的新一代 iPad mini，以及搭載 M6 晶片的更新版 iMac 及入門級 MacBook Pro。', 'paragraph_context': 'Apple is expected to unveil its first-ever touchscreen MacBook Pro later this month, with an announcement currently rumored for October 27. The company is also expected to introduce a new iPad mini with an OLED display, alongside updated iMac and entry-level MacBook Pro models powered by the M6 chip.'}

{'text': '說回今次測試版，其版本號為 26B5112a，這意味著它可能是首個 RC 版本推出前的最後一個版本。我們正深入研究系統，如有任何值得注意的發現將會向大家報告。', 'paragraph_context': 'Back to today’s beta, its release build is 26B5112a, which indicates this might be the last release before the first RC. We are digging through the system and will report back if we find any noteworthy tidbits.'}

{'text': '安裝 macOS 27.2 測試版 4', 'paragraph_context': 'Installing macOS 27.2 beta 4'}

{'text': '以下是安裝首個 macOS 27.2 測試版 4 的步驟：', 'paragraph_context': 'Here’s how to install the first macOS 27.2 beta 4:'}

  • {'text': '備份你的 Mac', 'paragraph_context': 'Back up your Mac'}
  • {'text': '開啟「系統設定」', 'paragraph_context': 'Open System Settings'}
  • {'text': '前往「一般」→「軟件更新」', 'paragraph_context': 'Go to General ⇾ Software Update'}
  • {'text': '按一下「Beta 更新項目」旁的「i」圖示', 'paragraph_context': 'Click the ‘i’ icon next to Beta Updates'}
  • {'text': '從右上角的下拉選單中，選擇「macOS Developer Golden Gate Beta」', 'paragraph_context': 'From the dropdown menu in the top-right, select the macOS Developer Golden Gate Beta'}
  • {'text': '按一下「完成」', 'paragraph_context': 'Hit ‘Done’'}

{'text': '你在 macOS 27.2 Golden Gate 開發者測試版 4 中有否發現任何新功能？歡迎在留言區告訴我們。', 'paragraph_context': 'Did you spot anything new in macOS 27.2 Golden Gate developer beta 4? Let us know in the comments.'}
